name: Lernweg · Campus
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a real background illustration for ClassJourney, a teaching display for Swiss vocational teenagers, wide landscape 16:9. This is the actual app background, NOT a UI mockup.
Art direction: premium contemporary editorial illustration with confident clean sculptural paper-cut shapes and a little tasteful 2.5D depth. Fresh, optimistic, punchy, visually distinctive, professional enough for an educational product, appealing to 16–20 year olds. Rich teal, cobalt, warm apricot, lilac and cream with a few sunny-yellow accents. Use a controlled palette of four main colors per scene, excellent harmonious color blocks and precise shape design, bright clean light. NO washed-out beige filter, hospital brochure photography, watercolor haze, generic corporate stock art or childish mascots. Avoid neon, rainbow clutter, stickers everywhere, faces or confetti.
Composition: a designed topical learning world whose objects sit mainly along the LOWER THIRD and OUTER EDGES. Keep the CENTRAL 55% and upper half spacious, smooth and mostly warm light cream so the app's text, clock and moving white cards remain readable. Strong colorful interesting forms at the edges, generous visual breathing room. A graceful narrow path or ribbon connects the outer scene elements as a journey motif, not a clinical procedure. No text, numerals, labels, branding, signs, app controls, cards, clocks, frames or watermark. NO mountains or generic landscapes unless explicitly called for. Theme: a lively modern Swiss learning campus. A curved cobalt walkway along the lower area linking a terracotta-red-orange stair and turquoise geometric school-building forms on the far left to an abstract apricot arch and a few sculptural plants at the far right. Low clean pavilion forms, a sense of exploration and a destination, no people. Playful architectural geometry rather than a landscape. Airy cream open middle and top. Tiny tasteful lilac secondary shapes. Bold elegant art direction.
